definitions.explanation: Changing the clothes on a doll or character. Also used for changing the visual theme or appearance of a device, app, or interface.

examples.japanese: {着|き}せ{替|か}え{人形|にんぎょう}で{遊|あそ}ぶ。
examples.english: To play with a dress-up doll.

examples.japanese: スマホの{壁紙|かべがみ}を{着|き}せ{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I changed the wallpaper theme on my smartphone.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{着|き}せ{替|か}えゲームに{夢中|むちゅう}になっている。
examples.english: My daughter is absorbed in a dress-up game.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着|き}せ{替|か}え{人形|にんぎょう}: dress-up doll
- {着|き}せ{替|か}えゲーム: dress-up game
- {着|き}せ{替|か}えカバー: changeable cover (for phones, etc.)

USAGE NOTES:
Originally used for doll play, {着|き}せ{替|か}え has expanded to digital contexts — changing phone themes, app skins, and avatar outfits in games.
